g.text: TP17 F5 OUTPUT: measurement only. No testpad is an authorized power input.

g.desc: TP17 F5 OUTPUT: measurement only. No testpad is an authorized power input.

g.text: POWER MEASUREMENTS: TP15 VIN1, TP16 BATTERY, existing TP4 SYS; separate from MCU pogo group.

g.desc: POWER MEASUREMENTS: TP15 VIN1, TP16 BATTERY, existing TP4 SYS; separate from MCU pogo group.

g.text: PMID bulk C20/C22/C24/C25: DNP in initial VSYS profiles; backup bulk is deferred.

g.desc: PMID bulk C20/C22/C24/C25: DNP in initial VSYS profiles; backup bulk is deferred.

g.text: SYS 6-18V -> 5.04V buck -> ideal diode -> J8 pin1 +5V, pin2 PGND. No MCU/USB control.

g.desc: SYS 6-18V -> 5.04V buck -> ideal diode -> J8 pin1 +5V, pin2 PGND. No MCU/USB control.

g.text: F5 OPTIONAL 5V / 2A: populate ALL U7 U8 Q10 L3 R60-R63 C60-C69 J8; F0 omit all.

g.desc: F5 OPTIONAL 5V / 2A: populate ALL U7 U8 Q10 L3 R60-R63 C60-C69 J8; F0 omit all.

g.text: VIN damping R12 2 ohm / C26 2.2uF 100V: selected prototype parts; VAC1 hot-plug qualification OPEN.

g.desc: VIN damping R12 2 ohm / C26 2.2uF 100V: selected prototype parts; VAC1 hot-plug qualification OPEN.

g.text: F1 prototype: Littelfuse 0451005.MRL, 5 A, 125 Vdc; qualify temperature, cable, hot-plug, polarity-FET SOA and coordination.

g.desc: F1 prototype: Littelfuse 0451005.MRL, 5 A, 125 Vdc; qualify temperature, cable, hot-plug, polarity-FET SOA and coordination.

g.text: PCB edge, 2.54mm pitch TOP view; triangle at TP5. UART high-Z while target off; NO power input.

g.desc: PCB edge, 2.54mm pitch TOP view; triangle at TP5. UART high-Z while target off; NO power input.

g.text: CE pull-up via REGN/MAIN diode OR. BQ25792 2S charger-only reset/default 2A risk OPEN.

g.desc: CE pull-up via REGN/MAIN diode OR. BQ25792 2S charger-only reset/default 2A risk OPEN.

g.text: Q5/Q6/Q7 default off; Q3 sinks CE only on request. Q6 is not a precision MAIN voltage monitor.

g.desc: Q5/Q6/Q7 default off; Q3 sinks CE only on request. Q6 is not a precision MAIN voltage monitor.

g.text: U3 SYS -> MAIN_3V3 buck; U4 USB_VBUS -> USB3V3 LDO; U5 normal-priority mux -> MCU3V3.

g.desc: U3 SYS -> MAIN_3V3 buck; U4 USB_VBUS -> USB3V3 LDO; U5 normal-priority mux -> MCU3V3.

g.text: SEPARATE MEASUREMENT ONLY: TP8 MCU3V3, TP13 MAIN_3V3; NOT in UART group. BOOT/RESET buttons retained.

g.desc: SEPARATE MEASUREMENT ONLY: TP8 MCU3V3, TP13 MAIN_3V3; NOT in UART group. BOOT/RESET buttons retained.

g.text: CHARGING: MAIN PRESENT AND FIRMWARE REQUEST

g.desc: CHARGING: MAIN PRESENT AND FIRMWARE REQUEST

g.text: OPTIONAL EMERGENCY UART: TP5 ESP_TX GPIO21, TP6 ESP_RX GPIO20, TP7 GND; no fitted header.

g.desc: OPTIONAL EMERGENCY UART: TP5 ESP_TX GPIO21, TP6 ESP_RX GPIO20, TP7 GND; no fitted header.

g.text: Complete power interruption: EN 10k/1u RC and GPIO straps restart MCU. Transition resets acceptable; hardware tests pending.

g.desc: Complete power interruption: EN 10k/1u RC and GPIO straps restart MCU. Transition resets acceptable; hardware tests pending.

g.text: PRIMARY SERVICE: native USB-C Serial/JTAG for programming, logging and debug; USB-only MCU power.

g.desc: PRIMARY SERVICE: native USB-C Serial/JTAG for programming, logging and debug; USB-only MCU power.

g.text: USB-only ROM flashing: BOOT held low during RESET; no battery/adapter required. Wi-Fi off in service firmware.

g.desc: USB-only ROM flashing: BOOT held low during RESET; no battery/adapter required. Wi-Fi off in service firmware.

g.text: PGND = system return; GND = quiet TS / PROG / NTC; NT1 local tie; no PCB moat.

g.desc: PGND = system return; GND = quiet TS / PROG / NTC; NT1 local tie; no PCB moat.

g.text: Provisional R12 / C26; validate on prototype

g.desc: Provisional R12 / C26; validate on prototype

g.text: The REGN LDO supplies internal bias circuits and the MOSFETs gate drivers.

g.desc: The REGN LDO supplies internal bias circuits and the MOSFETs gate drivers.

g.text: The pull-up rails of ILIM_HIZ, TS, and STAT can be connected to REGN.

g.desc: The pull-up rails of ILIM_HIZ, TS, and STAT can be connected to REGN.

g.text: The REGN is not recommended to source any other external circuit!

g.desc: The REGN is not recommended to source any other external circuit!

g.text: TP14 CE_N: separate passive charger-domain bring-up probe. No added RESET/BOOT/I2C pads.

g.desc: TP14 CE_N: separate passive charger-domain bring-up probe. No added RESET/BOOT/I2C pads.

g.text: SERVICE USB / ESP32-C3 RECOVERY - prototype, not fabrication approval

g.desc: SERVICE USB / ESP32-C3 RECOVERY - prototype, not fabrication approval

g.text: U1 project footprint corrected to 61 lands / 53 numbers; verify RF keepout, stencil and placement in PCB phase.

g.desc: U1 project footprint corrected to 61 lands / 53 numbers; verify RF keepout, stencil and placement in PCB phase.
